staging.logistics: Van is already staged on a prepared roadhead/service apron through expedition logistics. Travel to this remote region is a campaign transition; no new vehicle, ferry or flight gameplay is assumed.

circulation: Two physical cave entrances connect upper terrace and lower return shelf. Switchback reservations require generous terrain runs; no ladders, jumps or spectral-only shortcut can be mandatory for hunters. Terminal alcove stays a short branch.
systems: Sun/shade temperature, wind at mouths and dry cave reverberation remain environmental baselines. Named elevation bands replace ambiguous cave-floor room detection; rock walls must constrain both ghost controllers.
campaign: Archaeological record discrepancies and a later modern expedition form separate narrative layers. The culture and site are fictional; no real burial tradition is used as an evil source. Future explicit Diné/Navajo identity would require separate research/consultation.
refine: Third remote exemplar: shape actual irregular chamber polygons and switchbacks before building art.
The +4/+8 m terraces are reservations, not proven graded terrain. Engineer two-way routes, headroom and visible falls boundaries.
Modern rite installations must leave the fictional ancient fabric intact; validate all three against ghost interference.
sources: https://www.nps.gov/meve/learn/nature/geology.htm (text/search record inspected 2026-10-21: alcove-forming sandstone context only; no culture, plan or dimensions copied)
